days.title: High Peaks and Plateau Sights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: monte Viglio
stops.detail: The northern limit of the largest protected area in the Lazio Region coincides with the border of the Abruzzo Region, while to the south-west it follows the crest of Monte Viglio, the highest peak in the Park (2156 meters), then descends towards Pratiglio S.Onofrio following the valley down to Capodacqua, an area downstream from Trevi nel Lazio.

stops.name: Camposecco
stops.detail: It is typical of the Simbruini to encounter wide high-altitude plateaus (Camposecco, Campaegli, Fondi di Jenne, Campo della Pietra), which reach 500 hectares in surface area, and where one can observe the abundant presence of "holes" in the ground shaped like large funnels, namely sinkholes or swallow holes.

stops.name: Vallepietra
stops.detail: Among the birds, the golden eagle is of notable importance (especially near Vallepietra) in addition to the peregrine falcon (chosen as the symbol of the park) on the rocky walls.
